t: This is 68 Cadogan Square, a Grade II* listed house in Cadogan Square, in London SW1. It was designed by Richard Norman Shaw, a British architect who worked from the 1870s to the 1900s. He was known for country houses and commercial buildings, and is considered among the greatest British architects. His influence on architectural style was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s, so this house comes from the period when his work mattered most.
